quotes.speaker: Kyle Filipowski

quotes.speaker: Kyle Filipowski
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Filipowski on the impact of playing alongside another big man
quotes.excerpt: having another big out there changes my job a little bit
quotes.quote: Obviously having another big out there changes my job a little bit. Obviously my job is still to rebound, play hard, things like that, but it is definitely a different look we have playing another big alongside myself.
quotes.social_post: Kyle Filipowski on the adjustment of playing alongside another big man: It is definitely a different look we have playing another big alongside myself.

structured.context: Kyle Filipowski describes how playing alongside another big man changes his responsibilities on the court.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Filipowski
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Filipowski on preparing for the upcoming game against Denver
quotes.excerpt: trying to watch film, come together as a group, trying to learn from it
quotes.quote: Just trying to watch film, come together as a group, trying to learn from it, see what we could have done better down the stretch to keep it a closer game and try to get the win out of it.
quotes.social_post: Kyle Filipowski on the team's preparation for Denver: Just trying to watch film, come together as a group, trying to learn from it, see what we could have done better down the stretch to keep it a closer game and try to get the win out of it.
